title: Overview
description: Provides a high-level introduction to the AIGNE CodeSmith GitHub Action, outlining the problems it solves, its core features like AI-powered code reviews and PR summaries, and the overall workflow to help developers quickly understand its value.

title: Getting Started
description: A focused, step-by-step guide designed to get the action running in a repository in under 30 minutes, covering initial setup and basic configuration.

title: Installation
description: Details the process of adding the AIGNE CodeSmith workflow file to a repository and configuring the necessary secrets, such as the Anthropic API key, to enable the action.

title: Basic Configuration
description: Explains the most essential configuration options from the action.yml file, allowing new users to quickly customize core behaviors like model selection and file processing limits.

title: Guides
description: Provides practical, task-oriented instructions for leveraging the full capabilities of AIGNE CodeSmith, from customizing AI behavior to managing specific features.

title: Configuring File Scope
description: A guide on how to use path filters to precisely include or exclude specific files and directories from the review process, ensuring the AI focuses only on relevant code.

title: Customizing AI Behavior
description: Shows developers how to tailor the AI's review style, focus, and tone by modifying system messages and other prompts to align with team standards and specific review goals.

title: Interacting with the Bot
description: Explains how to engage with the CodeSmith bot directly within a pull request, including how to reply to its comments for follow-up questions and how to use keywords to skip reviews.

title: Managing Features
description: Covers how to enable or disable specific functionalities such as code reviews, release note generation, and automatic PR title suggestions to fit your project's workflow.

title: Reference
description: A comprehensive reference section that provides exhaustive details on all available configuration options for power users.

title: Configuration Options
description: A complete and detailed list of all input parameters available in action.yml, explaining what each option does, its default value, and how to use it for advanced customization.
